by: the quality rules each shape names, which refuse its syntactic signature where one exists
the classification step of the verification substrate, which files every silent failure under a shape before a fix is chosen
check.population: every source file the named rules lint, and every failure a check or a review classifies
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the linted source, a named rule or the shape's instances change
check.refusal: a named rule fails the lint stage on the signature; the invariant each shape breaks is gated in every structured document that grounds it
check.observation: the runtime observations that locate a failure, which are then filed under a shape
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: a suite plants a shape that names no invariant and no canon, and the bundled shapes validate clean
check.authority: the invariant the shape breaks, which the shape cites, while each named rule conforms to the shape's signature

records.name: No reachable check
records.shape: A representation that no check reaches.
records.fix: Declare the representation into a check's jurisdiction, or state in writing that it lies outside it.
canon: none: whether a representation is reachable is a property of the gate's jurisdiction, which no source rule sees

records.name: Empty domain
records.shape: A check that ran over an empty domain and reported a pass.
records.fix: Report the population beside every rate, and confirm at start-up that every name the check uses resolves.

records.name: Spent parent
records.shape: A parent counted as read while its children were never read.
records.fix: Subtract the read set from the child set and report what remains.
canon: none: a read set is known only while the run executes

records.name: Edge from spelling
records.shape: A dependency created because two names share a word.
records.fix: Join on the id the referent declares.
canon: none: a join on spelling reads like any other string comparison in source

records.name: Trusted leaf
records.shape: A node inside the graph that is trusted without a check, such as an exit code or a modification time.
records.fix: Route the node through a check that can fail, and disclose what no check can reach.

records.name: Lossy lowering
records.shape: A reshaped representation that dropped a distinction a later check needs.
records.fix: Keep the distinction, and refuse at the writer anything the layout cannot express.

records.name: Stale read
records.shape: A check that reads a representation the run already changed.
records.fix: Derive after the last mutator, and decide freshness by the fingerprint of the inputs and the code.
canon: none: no catalogued rule refuses a cache keyed by time or by lifetime alone

records.name: Two derivations
records.shape: One question answered by two derivations that can drift apart.
records.fix: Collapse them to one derivation, computed by the producer of the answer.

records.name: Weak link kept
records.shape: A link below the certainty floor kept in a chain with a flag on it.
records.fix: Remove the link from the chain.
canon: none: the certainty of a link is a property of the chain, which no source rule sees

records.name: Absence certified by observation
records.shape: No observed failure read as proof that no failure exists.
records.fix: Use the observation to locate failures, and leave the verdict on absence to a check.
canon: none: the shape lies in how a report is read, not in source

records.name: Stop on confidence
records.shape: A run that stops because the model is confident, before completion, saturation and verification hold.
records.fix: Stop only when the three conditions hold, or when the run is blocked on something outside it.
canon: none: the shape lies in how a run decides to stop, not in source

records.name: Unfailable floor
records.shape: A threshold set below what its population already meets, so the check it guards cannot fail until most of the population is gone.
records.fix: Set the floor from the population as it stands, and plant a case below it to watch the check fail.
canon: none: whether a floor can be reached is a property of the population, which no source rule sees

records.name: Verdictless verifier
records.shape: A tool named as a verifier that reports no pass, no fail and no exit code, so what it examines has no check at all.
records.fix: Give the tool a verdict and an exit code, or rename it to the probe it is.
canon: none: whether a tool issues a verdict is a property of its output contract, which no source rule sees

records.name: Unindexed construct kind
records.shape: A kind of construct the index a family of checks reads never records, so every check over that index misses every construct of the kind.
records.fix: Record the kind in the index, and confirm that a planted construct of the kind is reported.
canon: none: an index's coverage of construct kinds is a property of its builder, which no source rule sees
